gaps: ENTRYPOINT_CANONICAL_REPO_ORIGIN_HEAD_BINDING_GAP
Entrypoint accepts AAYS_REPO_ROOT or cwd and checks neither canonical origin URL nor local HEAD equality with the fetched canonical branch.
Pin repository identity and exact remote HEAD before any stage or output access.
ENTRYPOINT_AGGREGATE_OUTPUT_GENERATION_BINDING_GAP
Entrypoint loads seed, HMLR, numeric, Terrain50 and metric files by reusable latest paths without one invocation generation token.
Create a clean attempt generation and require every aggregate receipt to carry the same run_id and current stage SHA.
ENTRYPOINT_HMLR_EXECUTION_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_GAP
Fresh HMLR gate accepts process exit zero and matched_candidate_count=3 without requiring execution status, task, attempt, seed SHA or creation time.
Bind HMLR execution receipt to exact task, attempt, seed SHA, generation and current invocation time.
ENTRYPOINT_CURRENT_METRIC_ROW_IDENTITY_GAP
Current candidate metric contract checks row numbers and metric fields but does not independently bind exact parcel and HMLR identities.
Require the three exact row-to-parcel-to-HMLR bindings before aggregate success.
ENTRYPOINT_SUMMARY_STRICT_DURABLE_PUBLICATION_GAP
Entrypoint temporary replacement does not use allow_nan=false, fsync or parent-directory durability and uses a predictable shared .tmp name.
Use attempt-scoped strict JSON, fsync file and parent, validate, then atomically replace.
CARRIER_PRESERVED_METRIC_EVIDENCE_BLOB_PIN_GAP
Carrier pins canonical, point and HMLR evidence but does not pin the preserved EA metric evidence blob consumed by the entrypoint.
Pin the exact preserved EA metric evidence blob and publish the observed blob in the carrier receipt.
CARRIER_TRANSITIVE_MATCHER_AND_EA_SAMPLER_PIN_GAP
Carrier pins the HMLR preparation and numeric wrapper but not transitive executable scripts 010 matcher and 012 EA sampler.
Pin every executable transitive dependency and align queue, request, task, status and verifier blobs.
CARRIER_REMOTE_HEAD_ALIGNMENT_GAP
Carrier verifies the active branch name and selected working-tree blobs but not that HEAD equals the current fetched origin branch.
Fetch boundedly and require exact local HEAD equals approved remote HEAD before execution.
CARRIER_CANONICAL_ORIGIN_IDENTITY_GAP
Carrier does not verify that git origin resolves to the expected repository before trusting branch and blobs.
Pin canonical repository URL or repository identity before fetch, hash or execution.
CARRIER_GIT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_GAP
Carrier invokes rev-parse and hash-object without bounded timeouts.
Run all git probes through a bounded helper and persist timeout receipts.
CARRIER_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE_IDENTITY_GAP
Carrier selects the first python, py or python3 found on PATH without pinning executable path, version or hash.
Pin an approved interpreter path/version and record executable identity.
CARRIER_PYTHON_IMPORT_ENVIRONMENT_GAP
Carrier does not sanitize PYTHONPATH, PYTHONHOME or user-site loading before executing pinned scripts.
Use an isolated interpreter environment and record effective import paths.
NUMERIC_GATE_ARGUMENT_PATH_CONTAINMENT_GAP
Numeric gate accepts repo root, input and output paths without proving resolved containment under approved slot roots.
Reject symlinks and require every resolved read/write path to be within authorized roots.
NUMERIC_GATE_EXPECTED_WEB_ROWS_RANGE_GAP
Expected web operation rows are accepted from argument/environment without a positive upper-bounded contract check.
Require the pinned positive expected value and a safe maximum before generating or probing files.
NUMERIC_GATE_PARCEL_ID_CROSS_STAGE_BINDING_GAP
Numeric gate compares HMLR IDs across EA, metric and Terrain50 rows but does not compare parcel_id across all stages.
Require exact row, parcel and HMLR identity equality across every numeric stage.
NUMERIC_GATE_MULTI_FILE_TRANSACTION_GENERATION_GAP
Final output, execution output, preacceptance candidate and web output are written in several phases without one transactional generation.
Publish all files into an attempt generation, validate hashes, then atomically switch one manifest pointer.
NUMERIC_GATE_WEB_RECEIPT_GENERATION_FRESHNESS_GAP
After web verifier exit zero, an existing reusable web acceptance file can be loaded without run_id or creation-time binding.
Delete/quarantine stale receipt and require a current generation, candidate SHA and invocation nonce.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_CONTINUATION_KEY_BINDING_GAP
Recovery verifier checks task, attempt and revision but does not verify the canonical continuation_key in queue, request or outputs.
Require exact continuation_key across all control and receipt documents.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_TASK_CONTRACT_COMPLETENESS_GAP
Verifier does not enforce read_paths, exact_write_paths, resource_class, timeout, evidence and acceptance fields required by the continuation contract.
Fail closed unless the complete executable task contract is present and internally consistent.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_LIVE_RECEIPT_HEARTBEAT_CLAIM_GAP
Verifier named for operator recovery performs static source checks only and does not validate the four live receipts, fresh heartbeat or exact claim.
Verify receipt existence/hash/freshness, one live daemon, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim.
RECOVERY_VERIFIER_CONTROL_STATE_AND_STRICT_OUTPUT_GAP
Verifier does not align current task, status, checkpoint, heartbeat, ownership and manual action; its own output is direct non-strict JSON.
Read and align all control records, reject duplicate/non-finite JSON and publish an atomic strict verifier receipt.
